column1: # Bytes that are not UTF-8, as an ANSI save leaves them, beside well-formed UTF-8. A reason or line
# keeps well-formed UTF-8 as it is and writes U+FFFD for each maximal subpart of an ill-formed
# sequence: one each for the lone A3, A7 and B0 and the truncated E9 A3, three for F0 80 80, since
# 80 cannot follow F0. PositionLimitY holds the overlong C0 AF (two), E0 80 (two), the surrogate
# ED A0 80 (three), a kept U+1F600 and U+20AC, and F4 90 80 80, above U+10FFFF (four).
